# v0.1.14 preview

This artifact is a preview. It is not a claim of GitHub Actions
equivalence.

The version string is 0.1.14. The capability version is 12.

A poll pass records an error for one run and carries on with the other
runs. Final commit-status posts are retried with backoff. A new
`reconcile` subcommand re-posts final results for runs whose status may
still show pending.

The wheel and the source tarball can be built from this tree. They
are not published. This file does not create a tag.

The project license is the MIT License.

The App private key is not in the artifact.
